# Outlier

> Mac-native local AI runtime with a custom paged
> Mixture-of-Experts inference engine. Runs frontier-scale models like
> Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on 64GB Apple Silicon Macs by streaming
> expert weights off SSD. Offline, no API tokens, no usage caps.
> Requires an Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or newer) on macOS 26 or later.
> Includes an agent loop that plans, edits files, runs commands and
> tests, reads what failed and tries again, with per-action approval;
> MCP connectors, Projects, Code Agent v2, and six model tiers from
> 4B to 397B.

## Pricing
- Free: Nano 4B + Lite 9B, no account, no token bill
- Pro: unlocked by a one-time purchase, not a subscription - all six tiers including Plus 397B, Marathon mode, Computer use, Deep Research, context up to 128K tokens (Free: 8K)
- Founders Lifetime: $249 one-time - everything Pro includes, for the lifetime of the Outlier product, including all future model releases. Activates on up to 3 Macs at a time; 14-day money-back guarantee.
- Founding offer: 50% off ($124.50) for the first 25 buyers, with the code FOUNDINGOUTLIER at checkout; the site shows how many founding seats are left.
